source: ADHD Helper v1 plan — adhd-stack 49k card (NOT yet full niche-attack)

slot_rules.Assessment/lead page: High-intent route to a panel of private / Right-to-Choose providers. Capsule + visible FAQ + clinic-comparison (multi-provider = comparison table allowed). Qualified-enquiry CTA, no diagnosis on-page. Clinician-reviewed.
slot_rules.Product/shop page: Wirecutter-shape curation, no inventory. Affiliate (Amazon Associates / Awin / direct). EFSA-anchored claims only, NEVER 'treats ADHD'. Multi-product roundups get a comparison table; single-product picks get key-facts. Reviewer byline + disclosure.
slot_rules.Guide: Editorial answer to a real question (how to get assessed, RTC, waiting lists, med shortage, what helps). Capsule + visible FAQ, max-3 internal links, no FAQPage JSON-LD. Named medical reviewer + last-reviewed date.
slot_rules.Trust: Entity / E-E-A-T spine: named clinical reviewer(s), editorial + claims policy, affiliate disclosure, about/contact. Person + Organization schema, sameAs to reviewer profiles.
